original: 外国人の片寄った日本観が好きだ。忍者、変態アニメ、武士道などが出てくると本当幸せになる。

en.text: I like the one-sided view foreigners have of Japan. It makes me happy when ninjas, hentai anime, samurai and stuff like that come up.

original: 「お前、見かけによらず変態だな」「変態じゃないし。私は清純派の乙女よ」「はいはい、よく言うよ」

en.text: "Despite appearances, you're a pervert." "I'm not a pervert. I'm a pure and innocent young girl." "Yeah, yeah, give me a break."

original: 「お前、見かけによらず変態だな」「変態じゃないし。私は清純派の乙女よ」「はいはい、よく言うよ」

en.text: "Despite appearances, you're a pervert." "I'm not a pervert. I'm a pure and innocent young girl." "Yeah, yeah, give me a break."

original: 「トムどうしたの？」「メアリーに何カップ？って聞いたら変態って言われた」「当たり前だろ」

en.text: "What happened, Tom?" "When I asked Mary what cup size she is, she called me a pervert." "What did you expect?"

original: そういうのって、愛情表現じゃなくて「変態」って言うんじゃないの？

en.text: Isn't that more like something a pervert would say? Not someone expressing their love.
